::: {.ref-description}
The metrics are comparable to what scanpy.pp.calculate_qc_metrics output,
although they have slightly different names:

Obs metrics (name in this component -> name in scanpy):

  - n_features_per_cell -> n_genes_by_counts
  - total_fragment_counts -> total_counts
:::

::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Input h5mu file
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"input.h5mu"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--fragments_path`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Path to the fragments file. If not provided and not present in the input h5mu file,
the nucleosome signal and TSS enrichment score will not be calculated.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"fragments.tsv.gz"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--modality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Which modality from the input MuData file to process.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"atac"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--layer`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Layer at `.layers` to use for the calculation. If not provided, `.X` is used.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"raw_counts"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_fragments_for_nucleosome_signal`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of fragments to use per cell for nucleosome signal calculation.
Takes very long to calculate, for a test run lower value (e.g. 10e3) is recommended.
See https://www.sc-best-practices.org/chromatin_accessibility/quality_control.html#nucleosome-signal
for more information
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `100000`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--nuc_signal_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Threshold for nucleosome signal. Cells with nucleosome signal above this threshold
will be marked as low quality ("NS_FAIL"), otherwise they will be marked "NS_PASS".
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `2.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_tss`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of the transcription start sites to calculate TSS enrichment score.
See https://www.sc-best-practices.org/chromatin_accessibility/quality_control.html#tss-enrichment
for more information
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `3000`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--tss_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Threshold for TSS enrichment score. Cells with TSS enrichment score below this threshold
will be marked as low quality ("TSS_FAIL") otherwise they will be marked as "TSS_PASS".
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.5`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/qc/calculate_atac_qc_metrics/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/qc/calculate_atac_qc_metrics);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/qc/calculate_atac_qc_metrics/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
